description: EL11 : Accès limité - route express is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direction départementale des territoires (DDT) - Haute-Loire. EL11 servitude relating to access bans on the adjacent properties of motorways, express roads and agglomeration deviations. Coverage: Direction départementale des territoires (DDT) - Haute-Loire. The portal shows the English title as "EL11: Limited access – express route" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direction départementale des territoires (DDT) - Haute-Loire. Its keywords include inspire, route, opendata, servitude. The listing shows 2 download or service links in OGC:WMS, OGC:WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
